name: @platform/firebase-sa
description: The ONE Firebase service-account implementation for Workers: WebCrypto RS256 JWT-bearer -> Google OAuth2 access token -> Firestore/identitytoolkit REST, no firebase-admin. Hoisted 2026-08-16 from the auth-worker/discord-worker copies (the recorded follow-up in discord-worker's copy); scopes are per-consumer arguments so each Worker declares exactly the credential power it holds.
